title: Section 27 in The Indian Contract Act, 1872
snippet: Every agreement by which any one is restrained from exercising a lawful profession, trade or business of any kind, is to that extent void.Exception 1.—Saving of agreement not to carry on business of which goodwill is sold.—One who sells the goodwill of a business may agree with the buyer to refrain
